reviews.text: Contacted Innovative Projects and Design to install a gazebo. They did a wonderful and professional job. The worker were very respectful, professional and handled my property with care. It was a pleasure to work with Mrs Tiffany, always keeping you updated and making you feel comfortable throughout the process. Thank you for a job well done.
reviews.author: Marta

reviews.text: Great experience! Assembly of Gazebo went as expected. Mike and Chad were professional and polite and completed job in one day. The weather and heat were kind. I’m excited and ready to enjoy!
reviews.author: Dena Crecy

reviews.text: I gave Innovative Projects and Design a $3000 refundable cash deposit. Once the deposit was paid, other things were added that would increase the cost of the job. When we couldn't reach an agreement, I requested the refund of my deposit. The husband and wife owners then started coming up with reasons why I couldn't get my refund. First, they came up with a so-called 30 business day refund policy after the fact, that was never agreed to by me. They then later stated that they didn't have the money to refund me. The next thing I was told was that the wife's father had passed away and all business operations were halted. After that, they then tried to impose a 20% restocking fee and $500 cancelation penalty to reduce my refund and pay me in a cashier's check, which was also something I never did agree to. I did have to engage the DeSoto Police Department for assistance in getting my full refund. I believe this to be contractor theft because they had me to transfer the money to Carol Oglesby, who was not on the contract or in the business name.
reviews.author: ricardo White

reviews.text: "I recently hired Innovative Projects and Design (IPAD) for a complete pergola install, and I was extremely impressed with their service. They arrived on time and were very professional and courteous. The team paid close attention to detail and the pergola looks great! They cleaned up behind themselves and ensured that nothing was left out of place. The price was fair for the thoroughness of the job. I will post the final pictures when the pergola cover and concrete coating are completed. I highly recommend Innovative Projects and Design for anyone looking for reliable and high-quality  services."  Give IPAD a call and let them know The Porter's referred you. Thank you IPAD!
reviews.author: Bridgette Porter

reviews.text: Tiffany and her entire team were beyond excellent. Integrity is what drives this company. Not only did they save me money, the project exceeded my original expectations. I would highly recommend this company for any home improvement projects.
reviews.author: William Brown

reviews.text: Just had my fence and deck done by Innovative Projects and Designs, and I love it! The team was professional and fast, and they paid attention to all the little details. My backyard looks brand new. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Russel Falcon

reviews.text: The team was very helpful in making a decision on what I wanted. The told me what works best for the issues I was having. Thanks to the crew and the management and ownership. Excellent job again thank you all so much.
reviews.author: James Freeman

reviews.text: We have an old fence that now and then needs repairs.  I’ve had less than stellar experiences with companies in the past and expected no better this time.  Boy, was I wrong!  I entered my info on Angi and in less than 2 minutes got a call back!  Their workmen came in about an hour, assessed work needed, and called their office.  Again, I got an almost immediate call back.  I accepted the estimate and work began.  The owners came to check things over during the process.  If anything happens to my fence again, it certainly won’t be their repairs!  I’m very satisfied with the work!  The owners couldn’t be more friendly, helpful, knowledgeable, and professional!  If you’re looking to solve a fence problem, look no further!
reviews.author: Carol Lewis

data.summary: The reviews present a stark contradiction. Multiple positive reviews on Google/Angi suggest competent work. However, a single, highly credible and severe complaint about deposit theft and fraudulent behavior is replicated across Yelp and appears to be a major unresolved pattern. The BBB B- rating supports the presence of significant customer service issues. The positive reviews feel authentic but may not represent the full risk profile.
fake_signals: The severe, detailed complaint appears verbatim across multiple Yelp search result snippets, indicating it may be the only significant review on that platform, creating an imbalance.
Positive reviews on Google are generic and lack specific negative feedback, which is unusual even for happy customers.
authentic_signals: The 1-star complaint is highly detailed with specific names, amounts, and sequence of events, lending it strong credibility.
Positive reviews mention specific crew names (Mike, Chad) and project types (gazebo, pergola).
data.discrepancy_explanation: While Google and Angi ratings are high (4.5, 4.7), the BBB rating is a concerning B- and Yelp search results are dominated by a single, severe complaint about deposit theft, suggesting a significant unresolved issue not reflected in the average scores.
